cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for revenue paid electronically. Fouta was still rolling out to all taxpayers by the end of 2026 (COG-002).
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-15: COG-001 (August 2026) has taxpayers filing on E-Tax or Sydonia and paying taxes and customs duties online through Fouta, and COG-007 (2024) has e-tax and e-douane bills paid by mobile money, so the main taxes and customs duties are filed and paid electronically. No figure for revenue paid electronically, so not stage 5.
